task: Write a TypeScript function that takes an S3 bucket name and returns a promise resolving to true if the bucket exists and false if it returns a NoSuchBucket error, using the AWS SDK v3 S3Client and HeadBucketCommand.
Produce a JSON object for an AWS IAM policy document that allows s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::my-app-logs/* and denies all actions when aws:SecureTransport is false.
Write a regular expression that matches a valid AWS access key ID, which starts with AKIA followed by exactly 16 uppercase letters or digits.
